sourceAliases.note: No WooCommerce plugin profile authored yet for a Pinterest catalog plugin (e.g. Pinterest for WooCommerce); this alias is a forward-pointer for when one is profiled.

preferredWrite.surface: Manual -- no API; merchant verifies the site with Pinterest, then copies a feed link

pitfalls.summary: Unlike Meta/TikTok, Pinterest requires a site-ownership verification step (a Pinterest-issued HTML tag pasted into Wix Custom Code) BEFORE the catalog-link step. A runbook that skips straight to "Get Catalog Link" will fail — the merchant must verify the site first.

evidence.path: wix.stores_channels.feed.v1.catalog — BuildMarketplaceCatalogFeedUrlV2Request.FeedFile enum includes PINTEREST_XML (ALPHA maturity) — verified via docs-schema MCP, 2026-08-16

steps.text: On Pinterest, under site claim settings, click Claim next to Websites and Copy the HTML verification tag.
In the Wix dashboard, add that snippet via Custom Code (Add Custom Code) so Pinterest can verify site ownership.
Go to Catalog > Sales Channels > Pinterest Catalog, click Get Catalog Link, and copy it.
Upload/connect that link as the product catalog in the Pinterest business account.

manualSteps.mechanism: Pull-based feed; once the site is verified, product listings, updates, and price changes sync to Pinterest automatically/in real time per Wix's own description.
